directAnswer: Open your phone’s camera, point it at the QR code, and tap the notification or link that appears.
summary: Most modern iPhones and Android phones can scan QR codes with the built-in Camera app. Some Android phones need Google Lens or a QR scanner from the camera tools.

sections.heading: Using the Camera App
sections.body: Open Camera, keep the QR code in frame, and wait for the link notification. Tap it to open the website or app. On iPhone this works in the built-in Camera app. On Android it usually works in Camera, or through Google Lens / QR Code Scanner in camera settings or quick tools.

sections.heading: If the camera doesn’t scan
sections.body: If nothing appears after a few seconds, try better lighting, move closer or farther, clean the lens, or open Google Lens / a QR scanner app from your app store.

steps.title: Open your Camera app
steps.detail: Launch Camera on your phone. Photo mode is fine on most devices.

steps.title: Point your camera at the QR code
steps.detail: Hold the phone steady so the QR code is clearly in frame until the phone recognizes it.

steps.title: Tap the notification or link that appears
steps.detail: When a banner or link shows up (for example “Open example.com”), tap it.

steps.title: The link opens in your browser or app
steps.detail: Your phone opens the website or related app connected to that QR code.

faqs.question: What if my camera app doesn't scan QR codes?
faqs.answer: On Android, open Google Lens or QR Code Scanner from camera settings or quick tools. You can also install a QR scanner from your app store. On iPhone, use the built-in Camera app and make sure the code is well lit.

faqs.question: Are there any security risks with scanning QR codes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Only scan codes from sources you trust. A QR code can open a malicious site or download unwanted content.

faqs.question: Do iPhone and Android work the same way?
faqs.answer: iPhone uses the built-in Camera app. Android usually uses Camera, and sometimes Google Lens or a QR scanner tool.

caveats: You need a working camera and enough light for the QR code to scan reliably.
Be careful with QR codes from unknown sources — they can open unsafe links.
